summary: Audited the Agent settings page styling and updated instructions-editor.css so the instruction textareas (System prompt, Global AGENTS.md, project AGENTS.md) use the app's thin scrollbar convention and a subtle resize grip instead of the default browser scrollbar and blocky corner. The container also gained padding and gap. Verified visually via the running app and confirmed `pnpm check` remains clean with no errors or warnings.
decisions: Adopted the inspector panels' thin-scrollbar pattern (`scrollbar-width: thin` + `::-webkit-scrollbar` styles) for instruction textareas to match the rest of the app's visual language.
Added `gap: var(--space-3)` and `padding: var(--space-4)` to `[data-ui='instructions-editor']` so the editor card has consistent interior spacing.
Left the shared Button component's disabled styling alone since the same pattern is already used correctly in the skill editor.
